function.name: criminal_history_check_felonies
function.description: This function checks if an individual has any prior felony convictions based on their full name and birth date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

full_name.description: The full name of the individual.

birth_date.description: The birth date of the individual. Must be in MM-DD-YYYY format.

state.description: The state to search the criminal record in. Default to 'None', which the function will search across all states.
